applicabilityBasis.summary: FRNT is a transferable USD-par stable token with a statutory reserve-backed redemption obligation. The reserve rules expressly deny legal-tender, general state-obligation and federal-insurance status; state issuance alone does not establish a national-currency exclusion.

genius.notes: Wyoming Stable Token Act issuance authority and current administrative reserve/redemption rules are verified. These sources establish the state public issuer and special trust-limited obligation, not a GENIUS state-qualified PPSI approval. Token-specific federal approval, state-qualified approval and GENIUS application posture remain unresolved. Daily financial examination is announced, but no current signed report was retrieved; LedgerLens metrics are explicitly supplemental and non-assured. MiCA is not assessed because an EU offering or authorization mapping was not established.

references.label: Wyoming Stable Token Commission reserve rules effective September 23, 2026
